title: Clear prompts and output checks
goal: Specify a task and validate an answer before using it.
case: An office extracts amounts and invoice identifiers from synthetic invoices.
terms: State exactly which fields to extract and how to handle missing entries.
Use only the supplied invoice text; do not infer a value that is absent.
Validate names and types of returned fields with Python.
A missing value should stay null or cause a review flag, rather than be guessed.
steps: Compare a vague request with a field-specific request
Validate an extraction dictionary against the schema
Explain a failure caused by an invented total
example: Invoice INV-04 shows quantity 3 and price 12.
Extract ID and listed total if present.
If total is absent, return None; 3 × 12 is a calculated check, not an extracted listed value.
misconception: Valid JSON means the invoice facts are true.
correction: Syntax and data types are only the first check; compare values with the original document.
change: Delete one total and confirm the missing-field review flag fires.
metric: Fields correct / fields checked; report missing fields separately
lab: Run extraction validation on ten synthetic records.
output: Prompt revision and before/after field-check table.
reading: Google, Develop a generative AI application
